title: console: Edit in a record-drawer level opens the host route's object form ("Edit Sales Order" → "Record not found") — the header Edit passes no objectName and handleEdit drops formObject
body:
Found while building a metadata app on the published packages (downstream card: steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#42, held `pm:blocked` on this one). Reproduced on `@objectstack/console` 18.3.0; the same code is on `main` at `64551047`. Sibling defect in the same drawer-stack family, separate seam: the related-tab scope card filed alongside this one.

## Symptom

Open a parent record (`crm_cb_order`), open a child record (`crm_allocation_plan`) from its related list into a drawer level, click the level's header **Edit**. The form that opens is the **parent route's** object form with the **child's** id: title "Edit Sales Order", body "Record not found". The child's full page Edit works (control).

Reproduces from both hosts: the list drawer (`/crm_cb_order?recordId=…`) and the parent's full page (`/crm_cb_order/record/:id`, `RecordPageDrawerHost`).

## Producer (main)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:4681` — header `sys_edit`: `onClick: () => onEdit({ id: pureRecordId })`, no object name.
- Every drawer level receives the host's `onEdit` unchanged: `views/objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx:80-81` (list host, beside `objectNameOverride={level.objectName}`) and `views/RecordDetailView.tsx:5655-5656` (record-page host).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:1099-1120` `handleEdit` resolves the target from `currentObjectDef` (the URL path segment's object, line 958), sets `form=ID` and **deletes `formObject`** (line 1120, "Top-level task on the route's own object"); `formObjectDef` then falls back to `currentObjectDef` (lines 963-966).
- The URL contract already carries the child object for this case: `views/RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx:465-466` sets both `form` and `formObject = opts.objectName` for a child task. The header Edit path does not.

## Repro (18.3.0)

1. `/crm_cb_order` → open an order (URL gains `?recordId=…`) → related tab of the child object → open a child row → **Edit**. URL becomes `…?recordId=PARENT&related=crm_allocation_plan.cb_order&form=CHILD_ID` with no `formObject`; dialog "Edit Sales Order / Record not found".
2. Same from the parent's full page `/crm_cb_order/record/PARENT` → child drawer → Edit: `form=CHILD_ID`, same dialog.
3. Control: child full page `/crm_allocation_plan/record/CHILD_ID` → Edit → correct "Edit Allocation Plan" form.

## Suggested fix shape (for the lane to judge)

The header Edit of a drawer level carries the level's object (`onEdit({ id, objectName })`), and `handleEdit` writes `formObject` when that object differs from the route's — the same contract `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` already uses — instead of deleting it.

Dedupe words: record drawer edit formObject · drawer stack onEdit route object · Edit opens parent object form.
